name: changedetection.io
best_for: web change evidence, AI importance filtering, summaries, multi-channel notifications
risk: source-specific authentication, anti-bot and terms still require validation

name: RSSHub
best_for: normalizing public creator and social sources into RSS
risk: routes can break and some sources require cookies, proxy or self-hosting

name: FreshRSS + Extensions
best_for: feed aggregation, keyword webhook, LLM classification and digest
risk: no native KOL claim-version or human review data model

name: Visualping
best_for: no-deploy page monitoring with AI summaries and importance classification
risk: free capacity is far below production KOL scale

name: Huginn
best_for: self-hosted event-agent orchestration across web, RSS, webhooks and push channels
risk: high operating complexity and latest formal release is from 2022

name: Miniflux
best_for: lightweight feed backend, filtering, REST API, webhook and integrations
risk: AI interpretation and review workflow must be external

name: Talkwalker Alerts
best_for: brand, person and keyword mentions across web, news, forums, blogs and X
risk: no public completeness, capacity or history SLA for the free service

name: Inoreader
best_for: quickly validating a unified KOL reading pool
risk: monitoring feeds, rules and advanced social sources are mainly Pro features

name: Distill
best_for: low-frequency selected-area page monitoring and notifications
risk: free tier has six-hour cloud interval and no version history

name: Browse AI
best_for: structured extraction and monitored browser-task proof of concept
risk: very small free capacity plus authentication, CAPTCHA and site-terms risk
